topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: The scent of pine and earth fills my air, grounding me as I move through the familiar shadows of the trees. I had known of this other, a presence in my mind shaped not by sight but by the rhythm of words over distances vast and imagined. Today, the wind carries whispers of a different kind, of this presence now near, not just in thoughts but in the same space as mine. The brush of leaves underfoot is a dance I hadn’t realized we’d share. Each step, a discovery, a merging of worlds once apart. The world, it seems, just grew a little brighter, a little more alive.
